invariants.rationale: records must be non-null for streaming and grouping operations.
index is used immediately with isGlobal(), so must be non-null.
schemaStr is passed to HoodieSchema.parse(schemaStr), requiring it to be non-null.
props is used to call DeleteContext.fromRecordSchema(props, schema), so must be non-null.
parallelism is typically a positive value for partitioning/parallel operations.
